summary: Inline code (<code>) and keyboard keys or shortcuts (<kbd>).
whenToUse: Names of commands, files, properties; keyboard shortcuts.

props.name: Kbd.keys
props.description: Key combination, e.g. ['Ctrl', 'K']; alternatively use children.

inherits: Global HTML attributes; ref to the element.
accessibility: The “+” symbol between keys is decorative (aria-hidden); keys are read in sequence.
On macOS, consider showing ⌘ instead of Ctrl.
responsive: Inline code wraps to avoid overflow.
commonMistakes: Using Code to highlight words that are not code.
